# Changelog

## 1.0.0 (2026-10-30)

- Initial release of Custom Dashboard List.
- Dual-role landing page support for Supervisory Authorities (grouped accordions) and Operators (flat list).
- Dynamic query mapping for SQL metadata and InfluxDB time-series metrics.
- German number formatting with customizable units and decimals.
- Freshness evaluation with 24-hour transmission status indicator.
- Fully responsive layout: Desktop table dynamically converts to mobile stat cards on narrow screens.
- Quick link sections for centralized telemetry monitoring and meteorological weather data.
